```{r}
clinical <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Capstone Data/Clinical labs and metadata/sound_life_clinical_lab_descriptors.csv")

labs_meta <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Capstone Data/Clinical labs and metadata/sound_life_labs_metadata.csv")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)

glimpse(clinical)
glimpse(labs_meta)
```


```{r}
# force guids to character so R never coerces them to numeric
labs_meta <- labs_meta |>
  mutate(across(contains("Guid"), as.character),
         across(contains("guid"), as.character))

# standardize column names
labs_meta <- labs_meta |> clean_names()
clinical  <- clinical  |> clean_names()

names(labs_meta)
names(clinical)
```

```{r}
unique(labs_meta$subject_age_group)

labs_meta |>
  count(subject_age_group, sort = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# identifying key columns
SUBJ_KEY   <- "subject_subject_guid"
SAMPLE_KEY <- "sample_sample_kit_guid"
DAYS_COL   <- "sample_days_since_first_visit"
```


```{r}
# Baseline filter (Flu Year 1, Day 0)

baseline <- labs_meta |>
  filter(sample_days_since_first_visit == 0)

# if a flu year column exists, restrict to Year 1
if ("sample_flu_year" %in% names(baseline)) {
  baseline <- baseline |> filter(sample_flu_year == 1)}

cat("Baseline rows before dedup:", nrow(baseline), "\n")

# resolve duplicates, keeping rows with fewest NAs
baseline <- baseline |>
  group_by(.data[[SUBJ_KEY]]) |>
  mutate(.na_count = rowSums(is.na(across(everything())))) |>
  arrange(.na_count, .data[[SAMPLE_KEY]]) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-.na_count)

cat("Baseline n after dedup:", nrow(baseline), "\n")

# one row per subject and per sample
stopifnot("Duplicate sampleKitGuid" = !anyDuplicated(baseline[[SAMPLE_KEY]]))
stopifnot("Duplicate subjectGuid"   = !anyDuplicated(baseline[[SUBJ_KEY]]))
```


```{r}
# checking for nulls
cat("Null sampleKitGuid:", sum(is.na(baseline[[SAMPLE_KEY]])), "\n")
cat("Null subjectGuid:  ", sum(is.na(baseline[[SUBJ_KEY]])),   "\n")

# cast all numeric lab columns
categorical_lab_cols <- c("cmv_igg_serology_interpretation",
                           "infl_rf_iga_interpretation",
                           "infl_rf_igm_interpretation")

numeric_lab_cols <- names(baseline)[16:ncol(baseline)]
numeric_lab_cols <- setdiff(numeric_lab_cols, categorical_lab_cols)

baseline <- baseline |>
  mutate(across(all_of(numeric_lab_cols), as.numeric))

# missingness summary
miss_summary <- miss_var_summary(baseline |> select(all_of(numeric_lab_cols)))
print(miss_summary, n = 50)

# flag any column >20% missing as an exclude candidate
exclude_candidates <- miss_summary |>
  filter(pct_miss > 20) |>
  pull(variable)

cat("Exclude candidates (>20% missing):", paste(exclude_candidates, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```



```{r}
# age_group - cast to ordered factor
baseline <- baseline |>
  mutate(
    subject_age_group = factor(
      str_trim(subject_age_group),
      levels = c("Young Adult", "Older Adult")
    )
  )

tabyl(baseline, subject_age_group)

# sex - cast to factor
baseline <- baseline |>
  mutate(subject_biological_sex = factor(
    str_to_title(str_trim(subject_biological_sex)),
    levels = c("Male", "Female")
  ))

# race & ethnicity - cast to factor
baseline <- baseline |>
  mutate(
    subject_race      = factor(str_trim(subject_race)),
    subject_ethnicity = factor(str_trim(subject_ethnicity))
  )

# CMV - recode to clean factor; equivocal flagged
baseline <- baseline |>
  mutate(
    cmv_status = case_when(
      str_to_lower(str_trim(cmv_igg_serology_interpretation)) %in%
        c("positive", "pos", "reactive")               ~ "Positive",
      str_to_lower(str_trim(cmv_igg_serology_interpretation)) %in%
        c("negative", "neg", "non-reactive")           ~ "Negative",
      str_to_lower(str_trim(cmv_igg_serology_interpretation)) %in%
        c("equivocal", "indeterminate", "borderline")  ~ "Equivocal",
      is.na(cmv_igg_serology_interpretation)           ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE                                             ~ "Other"
    ),
    cmv_status = factor(cmv_status,
                        levels = c("Negative", "Positive", "Equivocal", "Other")),
    cmv_status_flag_equivocal = (cmv_status == "Equivocal") %in% TRUE)

tabyl(baseline, cmv_status)

# NLR - neutrophil / lymphocyte ratio
baseline <- baseline |>
  mutate(
    clinical_nlr = if_else(
      bc_lymphocyte_count == 0 | is.na(bc_lymphocyte_count),
      NA_real_,
      bc_neutrophil_count / bc_lymphocyte_count
    ),
    clinical_nlr_flag_undefined = (!is.na(bc_lymphocyte_count) & bc_lymphocyte_count == 0)
  )

cat("NLR — undefined (zero denominator):", 
    sum(baseline$clinical_nlr_flag_undefined, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# height and weight
med_h <- median(baseline$am_height, na.rm = TRUE)
med_w <- median(baseline$am_weight, na.rm = TRUE)

if (!is.na(med_h) && med_h < 100) {
  message("Height looks like inches — converting to cm")
  baseline <- baseline |> mutate(am_height = am_height * 2.54)
}
if (!is.na(med_w) && med_w > 200) {
  message("Weight looks like lbs — converting to kg")
  baseline <- baseline |> mutate(am_weight = am_weight / 2.205)
}

```


```{r}
summary(baseline$bc_neutrophil_count)
summary(baseline$bc_lymphocyte_count)
summary(baseline$bc_wbc)
```


```{r}
plausibility_rules <- list(
  
  # CBC
  list(col = "bc_neutrophil_count", lo = 500,  hi = 20000),
  list(col = "bc_lymphocyte_count", lo = 300,  hi = 10000),
  list(col = "bc_wbc",              lo = 1,    hi = 50),

  # Chemistry
  list(col = "chem_glucose",          lo = 30, hi = 600),

  # Lipids
  list(col = "lip_cholesterol_total", lo = 50, hi = 500),

  # Anthropometrics
  list(col = "am_bmi",    lo = 10,  hi = 80),
  list(col = "am_height", lo = 100, hi = 230),
  list(col = "am_weight", lo = 30,  hi = 300)
)

for (rule in plausibility_rules) {
  col  <- rule$col
  flag <- paste0(col, "_flag_implausible")
  if (col %in% names(baseline)) {
    baseline <- baseline |>
      mutate(!!flag := case_when(
        is.na(.data[[col]])                              ~ NA,
        .data[[col]] < rule$lo | .data[[col]] > rule$hi ~ TRUE,
        TRUE                                             ~ FALSE
      ))
    n_flagged <- sum(baseline[[flag]] == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (n_flagged > 0) cat(col, "—", n_flagged, "implausible value(s) flagged\n")
  }
}
```


```{r}
# rename lab columns with modality prefixes to match output contract
baseline <- baseline |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("clinical.", .x), .cols = all_of(numeric_lab_cols)) |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("clinical.", .x), .cols = starts_with("clinical_nlr"))

# separate flag columns to move them last
flag_cols <- names(baseline)[
  str_detect(
    names(baseline),
    "_flag_(implausible|undefined|equivocal)$"
  )
]

non_flag_cols <- setdiff(names(baseline), flag_cols)

clinical_baseline_wide <- baseline |>
  select(all_of(non_flag_cols), all_of(flag_cols))
```



```{r}
# Merge-readiness check

numeric_lab_cols <- names(baseline)[str_starts(names(baseline), "clinical\\.")]

# 1. Join keys — must be non-null and unique
cat("=== JOIN KEY CHECKS ===\n")
cat("Null sampleKitGuid:", sum(is.na(baseline[[SAMPLE_KEY]])), "\n")
cat("Null subjectGuid:  ", sum(is.na(baseline[[SUBJ_KEY]])), "\n")
cat("Duplicate sampleKitGuid:", sum(duplicated(baseline[[SAMPLE_KEY]])), "\n")
cat("Duplicate subjectGuid:  ", sum(duplicated(baseline[[SUBJ_KEY]])), "\n")
cat("Total baseline subjects:", nrow(baseline), "\n")

# 2. All lab columns are numeric (not character)
cat("\n=== COLUMN TYPE CHECK ===\n")
baseline |>
  select(all_of(numeric_lab_cols)) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ class(.x))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "type") |>
  filter(type != "numeric") |>
  print()

# 3. Missingness summary — which columns are >20% missing
cat("\n=== MISSINGNESS (lab columns only) ===\n")
print(miss_summary, n = Inf)

# 4. Quick summary of exclude candidates
cat("\nExclude candidates (>50% missing):\n")
cat(paste(exclude_candidates, collapse = "\n"), "\n")

# 5. Row count
cat("\n=== BASELINE DIMENSIONS ===\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(baseline), "\n")
cat("Cols:", ncol(baseline), "\n")
```


```{r}
# dropping 100% empty variables
empty_cols <- names(baseline)[
  colSums(!is.na(baseline)) == 0
]

cat(
  "Removing completely empty columns:\n",
  paste(empty_cols, collapse = "\n"),
  "\n"
)

baseline <- baseline |>
  select(-all_of(empty_cols))
```


```{r}
write.csv(
  baseline,
  "~/Desktop/Capstone Data/clinical_baseline_wide.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("clinical_baseline_wide.csv saved\n")
cat("Final dimensions:", nrow(baseline), "rows x", ncol(baseline), "cols\n")
```
